# PRT061 `non-portable-system-call`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

`system()` (a compiler extension) runs a shell command.

## Why

The standard `execute_command_line` (Fortran 2008) runs a command portably and reports its status.

## Reported

```fortran
call system('mkdir -p out')
```

## Preferred

```fortran
call execute_command_line('mkdir -p out', exitstat=status)
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[PRT061] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = PRT061` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `PORT061` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
